verified_findings.detail: ~875 LOC of the economics that constitutes merc's differentiation has no caller on the request path. billing_classes.go 0/7 exported symbols wired, batch_policy.go 0/5, prefix_routing.go 1/14 and that one only via dead batch_policy, exact_reuse.go 1/7 with the lookup path dead. Buyers pay full catalogue rate for byte-identical repeat requests while the reuse machinery sits unreferenced.
verified_findings.correction: An earlier crude grep also reported supplier_accrual.go and pricing_governance.go as dead. Both are LIVE -- accrueSupplierLiability is called from store_payouts.go and confidenceWeightedMedianUSDPer1K from pricing.go. The heuristic was wrong; the per-symbol check is what settled it.

verified_findings.detail: control/economic_plan.go:241 rounds supplierPerTask to 0 on small jobs while the buyer still pays a control-plane fee plus a safety fee that is 100% platform. small_job_economics_test.go characterizes the bug rather than failing on it.

Ledger and payouts are USD-only; the Stripe platform settles CAD. Code fails closed correctly, so no supplier cash can leave. Directive says use CAD throughout sandbox and keep currency explicit for a later migration.

measured_advantage.detail: Metal 14.4ms TTFT at concurrency 1 vs CUDA 181ms; CUDA 1617 tok/s aggregate at concurrency 16 vs Metal 211 with a 5.0s TTFT collapse. Opposite ends, sharp crossover, and a homogeneous fleet cannot exploit it because it needs two physically different machines, one outside any datacenter.
measured_advantage.not_yet_exploited: control/scheduler.go filters by hw_class and cost rank but nothing routes on workload SHAPE. The crossover is measured and unused.

honest_position: merc has partially built infrastructure for a verified heterogeneous compute market. The structural story is real and now has one measured advantage behind it. The money-complete, demand-relevant product is not finished: suppliers cannot be paid in real currency, small jobs pay them zero, and the reuse economy that would survive falling token prices is dead code.
